2607.07693.title: Selective Timestep Weighting and Advantage-Based Replay for Sample-Efficient Diffusion RLHF
2607.07693.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning generative models with human preferences. However, applying RLHF to diffusion models remains highly feedback inefficient, as existing approaches typically require large amounts of human or reward model evaluations. This limitation reduces the practicality of diffusion RLHF in realworld settings where feedback is the primary bottleneck. In this paper, we propose two complementary strategies that substantially improve the feedback efficiency of diffusion RLHF while preserving generalization to unseen prompts. Our key observation is that reward information in diffusion trajectories is unevenly distributed: not all denoising timesteps or trajectories contribute equally to learning from a reward signal. By emphasizing informative timesteps and trajectories during optimization, we obtain more effective gradient updates. First, we introduce a per-timestep weighting scheme that reweights denoising steps during policy optimization. We theoretically connect this weighting to the optimal convergence properties of proximal policy optimization (PPO) and approximate the resulting weighting trend empirically. Second, we introduce a replay mechanism that prioritizes informative trajectories, enabling the model to reuse past samples instead of repeatedly querying new rewards. Together, these strategies significantly improve the feedback efficiency of diffusion RLHF. Under identical hyperparameter settings, our approach achieves up to a 6$\times$ improvement in sample efficiency compared to widely used diffusion RLHF baselines.
2607.07693.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習從人類反饋（RLHF）已成為將生成模型與人類偏好對齊的強大範式。<lb/>然而，將RLHF應用於擴散模型仍然非常低效，因為現有的方法通常需要大量的人類或獎勵模型評估。<lb/>這一限制降低了擴散RLHF在現實世界環境中的實用性，因為反饋是主要的瓶頸。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了兩種互補策略，顯著提高了擴散RLHF的反饋效率，同時保留了對未見提示的泛化能力。<lb/>我們的關鍵觀察是，擴散軌跡中的獎勵信息分佈不均：並非所有去噪時間步或軌跡對從獎勵信號學習的貢獻都是相等的。<lb/>通過在優化過程中強調信息豐富的時間步和軌跡，我們獲得了更有效的梯度更新。<lb/>首先，我們引入了一種每時間步加權方案，在策略優化過程中重新加權去噪步驟。<lb/>我們在理論上將這種加權與近端政策優化（PPO）的最優收斂性質聯繫起來，並經驗性地近似了結果加權趨勢。<lb/>其次，我們引入了一種重播機制，優先考慮信息豐富的軌跡，使模型能夠重用過去的樣本，而不是反覆查詢新的獎勵。<lb/>這些策略共同顯著提高了擴散RLHF的反饋效率。<lb/>在相同的超參數設置下，我們的方法在樣本效率上相比於廣泛使用的擴散RLHF基準達到最高6$\times$的改善。
